name: Waterfall Wipe
description: Blocks of the second clip pour down from above the frame column after column, like a waterfall: in each column they fall one behind the other, land with a small bounce and stack up from the bottom, casting soft shadows on the first clip until the stack fills the frame. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: columns
params.description: Number of columns (the blocks stay about square, with at most 48 rows)

params.name: stagger
params.description: Share of the transition over which the columns start one after another (0 pours them all together)

params.name: bounce
params.description: How high the blocks bounce as they land

params.name: shadow
params.description: Darkness of the shadows and of the edges of the falling blocks

params.name: reverse
params.description: The columns pour from right to left instead of left to right
